LOOK: ⛩️ Cosplay Matsuri 2025 ⛩️ Convention Update!
Happening Now: A fantastic Q&A session with @kiyocosplay commenced on stage! Providing insightful ideas for fellow cosplayers. The Meet & Greet with Kiyo will be located at the Cosshoppe.

Coming UP Next: 
3:45pm Doujin Cosplay Duo
4:30pm Performance by As*Fire
4:45pm Trivia Game: Ano Na Wa
5:40pm Cosplay Carnival 2026 Special Guests Reveal
5:45pm Awarding Ceremony
6:00pm Cosplay Auction & Open Mic Karaoke

Day 3 Regular Tickets are already SOLD OUT, but Shopper's Pass (6pm-8pm entry) are still available! You can get tickets and other event information at https://t.co/gXM5tvCuvf

Revel in the snowy splendor of ⛩️ Cosplay Matsuri 2025 ⛩️: Winter Wonderland on December 28-30, 2025 in Function Rooms 2-5 at the SMX Convention Center Manila, Pasay City. Enjoy the Seasons of Cosplay unfold as we celebrate 25 years of cosplay together!

#cosplay #cosplayph #cosplaymatsuri2025
